title: Final Frequencies
description: Essential Criteria: Provide the correct expressions for the normal-mode angular frequencies omega_1 and omega_2.

title: Amplitude Ratio
description: Essential Criteria: State the correct ratio of amplitudes B/A for both normal modes.

title: Lagrangian Formulation
description: Important Criteria: Derive the Lagrangian correctly, including kinetic and potential energy terms.

title: Equations of Motion
description: Important Criteria: Correctly apply Lagrange's equations to derive the equations of motion for theta and phi.

title: Secular Equation
description: Important Criteria: Formulate the secular equation correctly from the derived equations of motion.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Avoid sign mistakes in the equations of motion or during the derivation of the secular equation.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Ensure that all terms in the equations are dimensionally consistent.

title: Small Oscillation Approximation
description: Optional Criteria: Clearly state the assumption of small oscillations and its implications on the equations.
